video_title: Raised in the Stands: Episode 1 - Mitchell Robinson

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on his preference for basketball over other sports
quotes.excerpt: I really just like playing basketball. I'm not really too big into other sports like baseball, soccer, football.
quotes.quote: I really just like playing basketball. I'm not really too big into other sports like baseball, soccer, football. I'm not really into it like that.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on the emotional weight of winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: It took me a while to process that. After the parades and stuff like that, it was unbelievable.
quotes.quote: It took me a while to process that. After the parades and stuff like that, it was unbelievable. For me, it felt a little different just because I've been there for eight years. Being there for that long, this is what a dream come true. I said it right when I got drafted, I wanted to see if I can have a ring there and you already got it. It was unbelievable. The feeling was so words can't even describe how I was feeling, and then to finally realize I'm an NBA champion, it was just like, we did it.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on the importance of his offensive rebounding
quotes.excerpt: I've been doing it all season long, getting offensive rebounds, and then for that one to come through.
quotes.quote: I've been doing it all season long, getting offensive rebounds, and then for that one to come through in the finals where it can get us to win the championship, it was just like all them rebounds, all them offensive rebounds really paid off. Now you see why they're important. That was my strength throughout the whole season, that and defense. So then it's like, that helped us win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on Deuce McBride's questionable music taste
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to go with Deuce. When Deuce be on the aux, it'd be like, I don't know about this song.
quotes.quote: I'm going to go with Deuce. When Deuce be on the aux, it'd be like, I don't know about this song. He got some good ones sometimes here and there, but I listen to rap a little bit, not too much as I do country, but some of the songs just, I can't get grooved into this, bro. So I'm just putting my headphones on and keep it going.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson identifies the biggest trash talkers on the team
quotes.excerpt: Probably Jalen. Jalen be talking shit sometimes. Myself, and then Miles McBride, definitely Miles McBride.
quotes.quote: Probably Jalen. Jalen be talking shit sometimes. Myself, and then Miles McBride, definitely Miles McBride. Once he get going, don't let him score on you in practice, because you ain't going to hear the end of it.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on Jalen Brunson's leadership and impact
quotes.excerpt: Jalen is so dialed in. He knows how to have fun, but he also don't want to take things serious.
quotes.quote: Jalen is so dialed in. He knows how to have fun, but he also don't want to take things serious as well, too. He get us going. Especially like for myself, if I'm lacking in something, if I'm not putting the effort in that I got 110% or whatever, he come give me a little pep talk and we talking, I'll be fine, I'm ready to go. He do that with everybody. Jalen is the guy that you can call and talk about damn near anything and everything.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on the coaching styles of Fizdale, Thibodeau, and Mike Brown
quotes.excerpt: Fizdale gave me my chance to actually go out and show what I can do to deserve my minutes.
quotes.quote: The way they like to play versus how Fizdale like to play and how Tom Thibodeau like to play, it was very different in those areas. I feel like Fizdale gave me my chance to actually go out and show what I can do to deserve my minutes. Thibodeau definitely helped me on my defense, and Mike definitely like on my communication on things, like just being more vocal. I feel like he helped me with that part. So all three of them definitely brought something to me to make me who I am today and as a player and stuff like that.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on what he will miss most about New York
quotes.excerpt: One thing I'll miss most about New York is really just pulling up to the games.
quotes.quote: One thing I'll miss most about New York is really just pulling up to the games, having all the guys, I know almost about the whole Madison Square Garden, even the ones that work at the practice facility. It's just, I talk to them a lot as well, like the security guards and all that stuff. Just the talk gets to know them a little bit. I've been seeing them for many years now and stuff like that, so it was just, I'll chat with them and then now that I'm not going to be there, I'm like, damn, I got to learn a whole new staff.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on expecting to get booed in his return to MSG
quotes.excerpt: Getting booed. I think it's going to be fun. It's going to be very competitive.
quotes.quote: Getting booed. I think it's going to be fun. It's going to be very competitive and stuff like that. So just, you know, when I think I go back, there's going to be some cheers and stuff like that I feel like as well.

quotes.speaker: Mitchell Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson on his favorite country artists
quotes.excerpt: If I had to pick for guys, it would be Luke, Luke Combs and then it would be Morgan Wallen.
quotes.quote: If I had to pick for guys, it would be Luke, Luke Combs and then it would be Morgan Wallen, Cody Johnson. I'm not really too big on Thomas Rhett, but I do listen to him a little bit. I do like Tucker Wetmore, yeah, he got some good ones. Cole Swindell, Dylan Scott, yeah, that's a few of them that I still listen to now and stuff like that. Oh, Brooks and Dunn. Definitely got to throw those in there. Toby Keith, got him in there too. Bailey Zimmerman. Yeah, it's a the list goes on.
